_about: Make-row category 'Parks' (Core/Tool/Shelf.cs; one file per category). Hide, never delete: type ids in hiddenTypes, style (preset) ids per type in hiddenStyles ({"park": ["pocket"]}), types moved in from another group in types. Hidden things keep their code and the game runner still builds them by id. Gardens fold into Parks. rf-parks (2026-10-16): cut to the best of the best, see docs/refactor/parks.md; picnic grounds fold into Park as the 'picnic' style. rf-shops2: the amphitheatre (Amphitheatre, Bandstand lawn) moves in from Shops & squares (the user: they belong in parks). Parks makeover (2026-10-29/30, docs/runbooks/parks.md): two new park styles, Country park (wild) and Neglected; every park, botanical garden, memorial park and adventure playground gets places with moods (gully, rocky knoll, wet hollow, meadow, copse, standing stones) and the parks' decal ground; the zen tea garden is hidden (in a clean game it is a block of trees). Dog runs are the park's Dog run amenity; picnic grounds are the Picnic lawn style. Biome mix (2026-10-30, docs/runbooks/biomes.md): every park style presets a mix of natural areas (lawn, meadow, flower field, mulch, glade, forest, rocky ground, heath, wetland, ponds); Woodland comes back (mostly forest) and the new Rocky park is mostly rock. P2-8 (2026-10-31, docs/runbooks/biomes.md): new styles Plain park (plain grass) and Open field (a mown field); Formal (a clipped city green with avenues) and Wildflower meadow shown again.
